description: Deterministic fixed-record file parameters shared byte-for-byte between the Java and Rust suites. Every variant (buffered read, mmap sequential, mmap random, mmap write+flush) reads or writes the identical 64-byte record format and must reproduce the same checksum oracle; the correctness suite always uses the small 'fixedRecords' profile so tests stay fast, never the 64 MiB or larger-than-RAM profiles.

fixedRecords.note: Correctness/smoke profile — 256 KiB, small enough to run in every test suite and CI without a large-file dependency.

sixtyFourMebibyteFile.note: The lab's primary benchmark dataset — large enough that sequential mmap access spans many pages and cold-vs-warm behavior is observable, small enough to be a routine smoke/dev-machine size.

largerThanRam.note: Capability-detected optional profile: only meaningful on a host whose configured size exceeds physical RAM. Not exercised by the correctness suite or the default smoke/publication profile on this repository's development or reference hosts; marked evidence-unavailable rather than fabricated wherever it would otherwise appear.

recordDerivation.checksum: checksum(id, value, payload) = fold: h = id*31 + value, then h = h*31 + b for every payload byte b (accumulated as a wrapping 64-bit integer, summed across all records in the file)
